title: fix: j/k step onto bundle rows without toggling them, enter and escap…
body:
…e find the right bundle

- BUNDLE_WRAPPER_CLASS came from OUTLOOK_CLASSES, which doesn't define it, so bundle rows were never told apart from emails; take it from CLASSES
- navigation walks every visible row in visual order; landing on a bundle row highlights it, enter expands or collapses it, escape collapses the selected email's bundle
- findReplacementRow keeps its own same-bundle search so an archive still keeps the selection inside the bundle

commits.messageHeadline: fix: a bundle that drops to one email gives way to the email, and ema…
commits.messageBody:
…ils follow category changes

- a bundle of one (without the bundle-one option) removes a leftover bundle row and shows the email itself in its natural place; a new bundle row starts collapsed and tucks away emails that were on show before it existed
- an email whose category is removed or changed drops the old bundle's markers and bundle-last-email, and follows its new bundle's expanded state
